@@ -0,0 +1,118 @@
+package kgateway
+
+// ConsistentHash defines consistent hashing load balancing policies for a route.
+// +kubebuilder:validation:XValidation:rule="!has(self.disable) || !self.disable || (!has(self.headers) && !has(self.cookies) && !has(self.queryParameters) && !has(self.filterState) && !has(self.sourceIp))",message="when disable is true, no other fields may be set"
+type ConsistentHash struct {
+	// Disable suppresses consistent hashing on a route. When true, no other fields may be set.
+	// +optional
+	Disable *bool `json:"disable,omitempty"`
+
+	// Headers specifies an array of HTTP request header hash policies.
+	// +optional
+	Headers []ConsistentHashHeader `json:"headers,omitempty"`
+
+	// Cookies specifies an array of HTTP cookie hash policies.
+	// +optional
+	Cookies []ConsistentHashCookie `json:"cookies,omitempty"`
+
+	// QueryParameters specifies an array of URL query parameter hash policies.
+	// +optional
+	QueryParameters []ConsistentHashQueryParameter `json:"queryParameters,omitempty"`
+
+	// FilterState specifies an array of Envoy per-request filterState hash policies.
+	// +optional
+	FilterState []ConsistentHashFilterState `json:"filterState,omitempty"`
+
+	// SourceIp configures hashing based on the client source IP address.
+	// +optional
+	SourceIp *ConsistentHashSourceIp `json:"sourceIp,omitempty"`
+}
+
+// ConsistentHashHeader defines a hash policy based on an HTTP request header.
+type ConsistentHashHeader struct {
+	// HeaderName is the name of the request header used to produce the hash.
+	// +required
+	HeaderName string `json:"headerName"`
+
+	// RegexRewrite optionally rewrites the header value before hashing.
+	// +optional
+	RegexRewrite *RegexRewrite `json:"regexRewrite,omitempty"`
+
+	// Terminal indicates whether hash policy evaluation stops if this policy generates a hash.
+	// +optional
+	Terminal *bool `json:"terminal,omitempty"`
+}
+
+// RegexRewrite specifies a regular expression pattern and substitution string for header rewrite.
+type RegexRewrite struct {
+	// Pattern is the RE2 regular expression pattern to match.
+	// +required
+	Pattern string `json:"pattern"`
+
+	// Substitution is the replacement string for matched pattern.
+	// +required
+	Substitution string `json:"substitution"`
+}
+
+// ConsistentHashCookie defines a hash policy based on an HTTP cookie.
+type ConsistentHashCookie struct {
+	// Name is the cookie name used for hashing.
+	// +required
+	Name string `json:"name"`
+
+	// TTL specifies the cookie time-to-live. Accepts Go duration string (e.g. "1h30m") or plain integer seconds (e.g. "3600").
+	// +optional
+	TTL *string `json:"ttl,omitempty"`
+
+	// Path specifies the path attribute for the cookie.
+	// +optional
+	Path *string `json:"path,omitempty"`
+
+	// Attributes specifies key/value pairs for cookie attributes (e.g. SameSite, Secure).
+	// +optional
+	Attributes []CookieAttribute `json:"attributes,omitempty"`
+
+	// Terminal indicates whether hash policy evaluation stops if this policy generates a hash.
+	// +optional
+	Terminal *bool `json:"terminal,omitempty"`
+}
+
+// CookieAttribute defines a name/value attribute pair for a cookie.
+type CookieAttribute struct {
+	// Name is the attribute name.
+	// +required
+	Name string `json:"name"`
+
+	// Value is the attribute value.
+	// +optional
+	Value string `json:"value,omitempty"`
+}
+
+// ConsistentHashQueryParameter defines a hash policy based on a URL query parameter.
+type ConsistentHashQueryParameter struct {
+	// Name is the name of the URL query parameter used for hashing.
+	// +required
+	Name string `json:"name"`
+
+	// Terminal indicates whether hash policy evaluation stops if this policy generates a hash.
+	// +optional
+	Terminal *bool `json:"terminal,omitempty"`
+}
+
+// ConsistentHashFilterState defines a hash policy based on an Envoy filterState object.
+type ConsistentHashFilterState struct {
+	// Key is the filterState object key used for hashing.
+	// +required
+	Key string `json:"key"`
+
+	// Terminal indicates whether hash policy evaluation stops if this policy generates a hash.
+	// +optional
+	Terminal *bool `json:"terminal,omitempty"`
+}
+
+// ConsistentHashSourceIp defines a hash policy based on client source IP address.
+type ConsistentHashSourceIp struct {
+	// Terminal indicates whether hash policy evaluation stops if this policy generates a hash.
+	// +optional
+	Terminal *bool `json:"terminal,omitempty"`
+}
